question: In December 2021, which of the following ministries tabled the draft Mediation Bill in Parliament?

options.text: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

solution:
Correct answer is__** ​Ministry of Law and Justice.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In December **2021**, the **Union Law Minister submit the draft Mediation Bill in parliament. **
 
• The bill was presented in **Rajya Sabha** on **December 20, 2021**, with a motive to reduce the pendency of cases in courts.
 
• The motive of the bill is to **settle any civil or commercial debates** through mediation before seeking court or **tribunal's intervention.**
 
• Mandatory mediation through courts has at present a **legal sanction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of Labour & Employment** is one of the early and chief Ministries of the Government of India. 
 
• The** Ministry of Education is a ministry of the Government of India**, in charge for the implementation of the National Policy on Education.
 
• The** Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship** is a Ministry of Government of India set up on **9 November 2014** to coordinate all skill development efforts over the country.​
